title: Wave Function Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The wave function for elastic scattering must be correctly expressed in its partial wave expansion form.

title: Phase Shift Behavior
description: Important Criteria: The qualitative description of how phase shifts vary with energy near the unstable levels must be accurate.

title: Angular Distribution Impact
description: Important Criteria: The explanation of how the variation in phase shifts affects the angular distribution of alpha particles must be clear and relevant.

title: Coulomb and Nuclear Forces
description: Optional Criteria: Mentioning the roles of Coulomb and nuclear forces in the scattering process adds depth to the response.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Failing to account for the correct angular momentum quantum numbers or misrepresenting the phase shifts can lead to significant errors.
